request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The viewer role is in place and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests (the main "viewer role" test and scenarios 1–3).

**Server**
- You can now assign `viewer` alongside clerk and steward. Any other role name is still refused, with the message "role must be clerk, steward or viewer". It fits in the existing roles table, so no database change was needed.
- A new first step, `settings/RefuseViewer.java`, checks the user's role before anything else runs. For a viewer it answers 400 "a viewer can change nothing" and nothing is written or audited. I added it to every change endpoint except loading a sheet, signing in, and the two bulk endpoints.
- **Bulk open and bulk settle** are deliberately left unguarded. The per-claim permission check already refuses a viewer, so the request goes through with 0 done, every selected claim refused, and no error. One edge case: pressing a bulk button with nothing selected still shows the usual "select at least one claim" error. I checked these two by reading the code; the test doesn't press them.
- **Missing features:** bulk reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date and void, the generate buttons, import and rollover don't exist in this app yet, so none of them has a viewer rule. Whoever adds them will need to give them the same "0 done, all refused" behaviour.

**Front end**
- The role field's placeholder now reads "clerk, steward or viewer".
- I fixed a bug the viewer test uncovered. Statement, hold and retire each have their own error on a person's row. A refused statement left its error showing, so a following refused hold showed two errors at once and the test step failed. The new `features/people/usePersonRowAction.ts` makes the other actions on that row clear their old error when one is taken.

The main viewer test takes about 36 seconds, compared with 16–21 for the other three. It passes, and I didn't look into why it's slower.
